title: The Loneliest Place on Earth
lines: There's a place on Earth so remote | that the closest humans are often in space.
It's called Point Nemo, | in the middle of the South Pacific.
The nearest land is almost two thousand seven hundred kilometres away, | in every direction.
When the space station passes overhead, | its astronauts, about four hundred kilometres up, | are your nearest neighbours.
The water here is some of the emptiest on the planet: | almost no nutrients, almost no life.
So space agencies use it as a graveyard. | Hundreds of old spacecraft lie on the seabed, | including the Russian space station Mir.
And around {2030~twenty thirty}, | the International Space Station is planned to join them.
Would you sail to Point Nemo? | Tell me in the comments.
